description:
Which one is better for a dog? Compare two to six places on the facts that decide a dog trip: dogs allowed, leash rule, where dogs may go, pet fee, weight limit, pets per room, restrictions, plus confidence, freshness and who confirmed each record. One row per fact, one column per place, every place with its citation.

Use after a search returned candidates and the user asks "which one?". Ids come from any search result. Example: ids=["carmel-beach","asilomar-state-beach"].

ids.description: Two to six place ids from search results

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: dogpolicies_compare_places

citation.description: Copy-ready citation: answer, source, date checked, record URL, license

confidence.description: stated: the place's own source says it; inferred_from_agency: an agency-wide rule; inherited_brand: the chain's policy, not confirmed by this hotel

freshness.description: fresh: inside its review interval; due: past it; stale: past twice it, confirm before you go; unreadable: the last check could not read the source

uid.description: Stable id that survives a rename

title: Compare places side by side
